title: Zia Memorial Museum, Chittagong
geometryBasis: The named 17-corner historic museum footprint establishes the stepped south elevation, two end blocks, central entry projection and rear recesses.
sectionBasis: Field survey records two storeys and brick masonry. The museum’s annual report records white walls. The eyewitness account establishes the upper verandah, and the 2025 in-person site report describes red tiles and tall windows.
limitations: The model represents the standing historic Circuit House, using its exact mapped perimeter, two-storey brick envelope, white plaster, red roof tiles, tall windows and documented upper verandah.
The three mapped facade projections constrain the principal masses. Gable profiles, sash arrangement, veranda bays, later exterior fittings, ornamental work and building levels remain estimates.
The original site height field is preserved. Entrance steps and foundation heights use an approximate local grade.
